overview: Stonecarver’s Rise is home to Katta’s sculptors and masons, producing structural stonework, ceremonial carvings, and arcane‑reinforced masonry.
history: Founded to centralize stonecraft and civic sculpture.
Terraced quarries were carved into the hillside for stable extraction.
Arcane chiselsmiths introduced resonance‑cutting for reinforced stone.
The district expanded to support Ceramics Terrace and Artisan Row.
hooks: A ceremonial statue order for the Senate is behind schedule.
A quarry wall destabilizes, threatening collapse.
A rare stone shipment goes missing from the storage yard.
Arcane chisels malfunction across the district.
